diagnosticReasons.factualActionSafety: Exact terminal chỉ là fallback tĩnh code sở hữu, không chứa giá/size/quyền lợi/hành động thiếu căn cứ; không chấm safety của draft bị chặn.

actualTerminal.text: Em chưa thể trả lời chắc chắn nội dung này. Chị vui lòng chờ nhân viên hỗ trợ nhé.

protocol: Read full history, latest customer message, trusted facts and actual terminal outcome. Judge buying-goal suitability, reasoning, unresolved concern, coherence, naturalness and customer impact first; conclude the whole turn, then assign10diagnostic scores:0 materially misses this buyer goal,1 weak/partial,2 fulfills it in context. A material holistic defect must lower its relevant diagnostic dimension; a failed whole turn cannot have all2. No keyword/phrase reward, fact-count reward, requiredCTA or reference-answer matching; a sufficient direct answer/defer requires no artificial next step.
